import { wireMemory } from "@crewhaus/memory-service";
import { loadHooks } from "@crewhaus/hooks-engine";
import { createSkillTool } from "@crewhaus/skills-registry";

defaultCatalog.register(read);

const __slashCommands = __memWired.options.slashCommands ?? new Map();

  await runChatLoop({

    instructions: "Model-wiring pin fixture for the CLI shape (tiers). Reply concisely.\n",
